# Demo ETL

Six-cell demo notebook used by the Ronin v0.1 acceptance journey.

import json, pathlib
rows = [{"id": i, "region": "eu" if i % 2 else "us"} for i in range(100)]
pathlib.Path('/tmp/customers.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows))
print(f'extracted {len(rows)} customers')

import json, pathlib
rows = [{"id": i, "customer_id": i % 100, "amount": i * 3} for i in range(500)]
pathlib.Path('/tmp/orders.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows))
print(f'extracted {len(rows)} orders')

import json, pathlib
totals = json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/totals.json').read_text())
assert set(totals) == {'eu', 'us'}, totals
assert all(v > 0 for v in totals.values()), totals
print('quality checks passed')

import json, pathlib
totals = json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/totals.json').read_text())
print(json.dumps({'dataset': 'revenue_by_region', 'rows': len(totals), 'totals': totals}))
